newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold revises West Rand merger ratios.
newsitem.headline: Randgold revises West Rand merger ratios.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd on Tuesday detailed revised ratios for its West Rand merger of Buffelsfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd, Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd and Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd.

Buffels shareholders will now be entitled to 110 Durban Deep ordinary shares per 100 shares held and Blyvoor shareholders to 25 per 100, the company said in a statement. The original ratios were 77 per 100 in the case of Buffels and 20 in the case of Blyvoor.
The terms for the Blyvoor options remain unchanged at 20 new Durban Deep options per 100.
The company had announced earlier that it planned to change the ratios.

Chairman Roger Kebble said the decision had been driven by the downturn in the gold price, which earlier this month hit a 12-year low. Kebble added the current depressed state of the market made the case for a merger more compelling than ever.
